summary: Retain explicit unknown-exit evidence for vanished one-shot workers and explain retirement on waiting mission steps and runs.

replay.detail: No replay or recovery trigger changes. New terminal observations retain exit diagnostics; existing historical observations are not rewritten.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema version changes. Additional diagnostic keys use the existing runtime observation fields.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness schema changes. Existing optional exit-evidence JSON gains observation metadata and an explicit unknown diagnostic. Older readers can ignore those keys; mixed-version execution has not been exercised.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal binary upgrade; restart-to-API and restart-to-health were not measured.

manual.detail: No manual migration or recovery steps. One-shot retirement and restart policy are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No storage migration or new recovery procedure. Swapping back retains existing observation claims, but older binaries do not produce the new unknown-exit diagnostic.
